resampling.type: paired fixed-size empirical bootstrap with replacement; conditional on the observed images and three frozen generation banks
resampling.bank_policy: A334/B333/C333 rounds, shuffled by PCG64 SeedSequence([2026,0]); exactly the same bank in both methods and control classes
resampling.generated_index_policy: 27 indices from the 40 sorted class slots, PCG64 SeedSequence([2026,1]); shared Raw/MSDF and Flash/Black
resampling.real_index_policy: 27 indices from the sorted class reference ROIs, PCG64 SeedSequence([2026,2,class_index]); shared Raw/MSDF
resampling.feature_population: ROI only, original Experiment1 cached 2048-dimensional Inception features, no re-extraction or projection
resampling.FID_KID_implementation: exact Experiment1 torch-fidelity source files and version; no low-rank replacement, alternate formula or backbone
resampling.KID_options: exact Experiment1 options,100 subsets,subset size27,seed42,unscaled,negative values retained
resampling.summary: mean,median,linear percentiles2.5/97.5 of paired deltas,P(delta>0); resampling fractions are not frequentist p-values
resampling.robust_black_gap: both Black FID and KID paired delta percentile intervals strictly above zero
resampling.CI_limit: conditional empirical resampling interval, not uncertainty over independently retrained generators or a population-level causal claim

appearance.region: unchanged Experiment1 bbox+25%-each-side ROI, native pixels
appearance.gray_std: population SD ddof0 in pixel units
appearance.RMS_contrast: sqrt(mean((gray/255 - mean(gray/255))**2)); same contrast quantity as gray_std/255,not independent evidence
appearance.RGB: channel population mean and SD ddof0,range0..255
appearance.Sobel: fixed3x3 Sobel kernels divided by8,reflect padding; mean sqrt(gx^2+gy^2),no threshold or density cutoff
appearance.summary: per ROI records; method/class/bank mean,median,sample SD,IQR; pooled descriptive generated summaries are not independent-bank inference
appearance.association_rule: nearest-real min and top3 paired mean delta CI both>0 AND both gray_mean and RMS_contrast absolute mean-deviation-from-real delta CI>0; no weighted score or duplicate contrast vote

secondary_bootstrap.unit: unique matched slot after averaging A/B/C within slot; paired resampling of all40 class slots or80 overall slots
secondary_bootstrap.seed_policy: PCG64 SeedSequence([2026,10,cohort_index]); same indices for Raw and MSDF and all requested secondary metrics
secondary_bootstrap.appearance_real_seed_policy: PCG64 SeedSequence([2026,11,class_index]); resample all class real ROIs with replacement
secondary_bootstrap.CI: linear2.5/97.5 percentiles of paired mean deltas

nearest_real_LPIPS.implementation: official lpips AlexNet v0.1; exact Experiment1 package/source hashes,weights,256x256 PIL bilinear,RGB/127.5-1,normalize=False
nearest_real_LPIPS.comparison: each frozen generated ROI to all same-class real ROIs; save min and mean of3 nearest distances; no generated-image selection
nearest_real_LPIPS.interpretation: nearest-reference diagnostic only,not a new formal realism metric

background.P: frozen geometry.paste_valid_crop_region_xyxy,not the full canvas and not padded generator canvas
background.B: original generation rasterized_mask_xyxy_exclusive translated by fixed_crop_xyxy origin,clipped to P; no new bbox or mask
background.MSE_PSNR: skimage.metrics on RGB values at all P-minus-B pixels,data_range255; PSNR is in dB,MSE in squared pixel units
background.SSIM: skimage.metrics.structural_similarity,RGB,channel_axis2,win_size11,gaussian_weightsTrue,sigma1.5,use_sample_covarianceFalse,data_range255,fullTrue; average channel-mean map only where the complete11x11 window lies inside P-minus-B
background.SSIM_border_rule: 5-pixel erosion of P-minus-B,excludes windows touching bbox or patch boundary; report pixel counts,no canvas-minus-P contribution
background.zero_MSE: retain Infinity PSNR in CSV; if any nonfinite per-slot PSNR prevents a paired summary,report unavailable explicitly,do not drop rows or cap PSNR
background.association_rule: paired mean delta CI: PSNR upper<0 AND SSIM upper<0 AND MSE lower>0

geometry: original normalized width,height,area and pixel aspect ratio (width*canvas_width)/(height*canvas_height); synthetic counted once per matched slot,not6 duplicated method/bank samples; cannot explain paired method gap by itself

visualization.selection: random.Random(2026),sorted slot IDs,12 unique matched slots per class,4 each bank A/B/C; no ranking
visualization.real_reference_role: no direct held-out reference link is present; show N/A rather than inventing a matched real exemplar or substituting a TRAIN donor
visualization.panels: conditioning normal,Raw,MSDF valid patch and original ROI zoom;24 groups retained
visualization.residual: mean-channel absolute RGB difference in valid patch,common magma scale0..255 for every image/method; no per-image autoscale

conclusion_rule: if both Black delta CIs>0: classify association with local appearance/background/both when corresponding predeclared rules hold,else mechanism unresolved; otherwise NOT_ROBUST_UNDER_RESAMPLING. Flash uses identical diagnostics and is reported as control; shared shifts are not called Black-specific
